children: Switzerland energy-efficient building tech provider's H1 sales were flat, EPS rose 8% yr/yr
Company benefited from strong demand for energy-efficient solutions and renovation activity
Burkhalter expanded via five acquisitions, strengthening regional presence and specialist expertise
Burkhalter expects a moderate increase in earnings per share for 2026 vs 2025
Company confirms positive outlook for 2026 financial yr based on strong market demand
Burkhalter says acquisition strategy remains a key pillar of sustainable growth
ENERGY-EFFICIENT SOLUTIONS DEMAND - Co said strong demand for energy-efficient building technology solutions supported results
ACQUISITIONS - Co said targeted acquisitions expanded regional presence and specialist expertise, supporting growth
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction & engineering peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Burkhalter Holding AG is CHF145.00, about 10.9% above its September 4 closing price of CHF130.80
The stock recently traded at 20 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 26 three months ago
